change: Shifted the base palette from the cool blue-grey #111723 to a warm charcoal and the neutral inks to warm greys. Device tints keep their families.
why: Palette is the app's overall look.

change: Changed the accent blue used for prominent buttons, selected tab, links and toggles to a teal, and updated the matching tint tokens.
why: The accent colour is on every screen.

change: The signed-in shell no longer forces the dark appearance. Pages now follow the system light or dark setting, with new light variants of the page and module surfaces.
Page and section titles now use the rounded system design everywhere. Body text is unchanged.
Raised the base text size one step: body copy moves from .subheadline to .body in rows, tiles and sheets through the typography tokens.
why: Type scale applies to every screen.

change: Replaced the app font with a bundled custom typeface for titles, labels and values.
Redrew the app icon as a white S+H monogram on deep blue, with new dark and tinted variants.
The default app icon changed from the house glyph to a plain monogram, and the in-app About row now shows it.
The tab bar goes from five tabs to four. Chores moves into a More menu.
Tab labels are removed. The tab bar now shows icons only.
why: A small tab bar change, but it appears on every screen.

change: The selected tab tint changed from white to the accent blue.
why: Small change to the tab bar every screen shows.

change: The default tab order changes so Chores comes first and Home second.
The tab bar becomes a floating Liquid Glass pill that hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up.
The flyout menu is replaced by a Menu tab that lists every section.
On iPad and the unfolded Duo in landscape the flyout is a persistent sidebar. Phones keep the overlay.
Home's Quick Links sheet is removed and every section is reachable from a grid on a new Sections tab.
Every page push and pop now uses a shared spring with a slight parallax of the wallpaper, defined once in MotionTokens.
why: Page motion shared by every page.

change: All pushes in the app now slide with the same curve and duration, and pops reverse it. Tab switches cross-fade.
Every page's title moves from inline to a large title that collapses on scroll, through the page base.
The back button on every pushed page is a chevron only, with no previous-title label.
why: Header component on every pushed page.

change: A connection status pill now sits in the header of every page, replacing the separate offline chip.
Every page gets a bottom-right circular quick-add button for a shared action sheet.
why: A component added to every screen.

change: The house photo behind every page is replaced by a plain dark gradient.
The wallpaper scrim is darker and the blur default raised, so every page behind the content changes.
Tile and module corner radii move from 16 and 20 pt to 22 and 26 pt in the tokens.
why: Radius tokens drive almost every surface.

change: The spacing scale tokens are tightened (m 12 to 10, l 16 to 14, xl 24 to 20).
why: Spacing scale used on every screen.

change: Icons across the app move from regular to semibold weight through the symbol map default.
The soft top-edge effect under headers is replaced by a solid blurred header bar on every page.
The launch screen, display name and in-app sign-in logo are updated to a new wordmark.
The tab badge style (colour, size, position) changes for every tab.
The tab bar hides while scrolling down on every page and returns on scroll up.
why: Tab bar behaviour on all pages.

change: Swiping from the left edge of any tab root now opens the flyout, and the flyout lists every section.
Each page's header is now a shared component with a title, trailing action slot and subtitle line, replacing the per-page headers.
The Dynamic Type scale is capped at AX3 for all text and the layout policies reflow accordingly.
The headline and caption styles in the typography tokens are re-weighted (headline semibold to bold, caption regular to medium) for all text in the app.
Dark pages now use a deep navy background colour in place of the blurred photo under the scrim when Reduce Transparency is off.
The device tint families (lights, climate, water, security) are re-chosen in the tokens, so every tile, icon and wash changes colour.
The page base's content margins on iPhone widen from 16 to 20 pt, so every page's layout shifts in.
A new global search entry in the header opens from any page.
The tab bar's icons are replaced with a new custom icon set.
The Rooms page status rail gets a fifth chip for Air Quality.
The Thermostat dial gets a thicker track and a larger target value.
The Mapped map draws room outlines in a lighter stroke.
The Security System sheet's arm button is bigger and tinted by state.
Chores rows show the assignee's avatar at the trailing edge.
The Sprinklers page lays pills out in two columns on iPad landscape.
The Food hub's Recipes tile gets a new photo and a subtitle.
The 'Added to Grocery List' toast now says how many items were added.
The chore Undo window goes from 5 s to 4 s.
why: A timing change on one control.

change: The Weather sheet's Done button becomes an X.
The Contact Sensors chip counts only entities in the 'on' state.
The image card used by Recipes gets a 20 pt radius and a bottom gradient. Recipes is the only page that uses it.
why: Restyled shared component with a single consumer.

change: The GlassTile's on-state wash is brightened. It is used on Rooms and Lights pages only.
why: A component in a few places.

change: StatusPill gets a filled capsule. It appears on the Sprinklers page and in the humidifier sheet.
The thermostat hub pill menu stays open after a choice.
The Camera tiles gain a bottom gradient behind the name.
The tab bar badge on Chores no longer vanishes for a few seconds after reconnecting.
why: A bug in one badge, no look change.

change: The offline chip appears only after 10 s offline.
The Media remote's Apps tab uses four columns on iPhone.
The vacation checklist title shows '3 of 5 done'.
Solo Trip traveler buttons show an avatar beside the name.
The Reset All Lights button asks for confirmation.
Scan Item gets a torch button in the top right.
The Recipes sort sheet gets a Cook time option.
The Performance screen gets a summary card at the top.
The About row on Settings shows the date version.
The Rain delay picker offers 12, 24 and 48 hours.
The wallpaper blur slider in Settings gets a preview strip.
The Living Room remote renders its layout straight away and fills app icons in as they load.
The Climate page's Whole Home section uses the same high as the weather card.
The app now remembers the last Chores sub-page for 30 minutes after backgrounding.
Settings topic pages pop with a left-edge swipe.
why: A gesture on one set of pages.

change: The Inventory list rows get a 44 pt product thumbnail.
The Expiring Soon section turns orange at 7 days.
The Garage tile shows a spinner and 'Opening…' after the command is acknowledged.
The Front Door lock tile reads its state from the lock entity instead of the contact sensor.
Camera streams are kept for 30 s when you leave a camera page.
The dishwasher tile opens a room device sheet laid out like the fan sheet.
The grill and fan sheets open at a medium detent.
The lock screen Live Activity stops saying 'Updating…' after a few minutes.
The home-screen widget shows who is home and whether the front door is locked.
why: A new widget, app look untouched.

change: The Home screen weather card shows a 7 day strip instead of 5.
The Lights page shows a Copy Color From picker with colour names.
The Security page lists open doors A to Z.
The Vacuums page status tiles include the bin level.
The cleaning report map no longer shows room names.
The Chores quick links are reordered to match the web.
The recipe detail ingredient list gets checkboxes.
The check row in Chores and Vacation gets a 44 pt hit area.
Swipe rows on Chores add a Snooze action beside Edit. Chores is the only page with swipe rows.
why: A shared component with one consumer.

change: The page indicator dots under the Home weather card carousel are smaller.
The floating action bar's Add Task button says 'New Chore'.
The Admin page lists Guests above Users.
The sprinkler battery warning shows at 30%.
The thermostat haptic fires on whole degrees only.
The Sprinklers sheet's Stop watering label is darker in light mode.
The tab bar's Chores badge counts only open items.
why: A count fix, tab bar look untouched.

change: Ticker labels scroll at a slower speed on the Media page.
The weather sheet's hourly strip scrolls to the current hour on open.
The Cameras page fits four tiles per row on iPad landscape.
